FN-F9N85DD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 119
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kerry Underwood
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 119 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Licensure Board for
Interpreters and Transliterators until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This
bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
